notes.title: Summer Devblog 🌞
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3][p][/p][p align="justify"]First off, thank you so much for all your interest in [i]MIO: Memories in Orbit[/i]! The past few weeks have been very intense (in the best way possible), between [b]the [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-9CEXlm3phE"]Summer Game Fest[/url][/u][/b],[b] the release of our [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ETCpWo0A0i0"]gameplay trailer[/url][/u][/b], [b]our participation in the Steam Next Fest[/b] and [b][url="https://x.com/MIOinOrbit/status/1958897390401794194"]gamescom[/url][/b].[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]And we’re happy to say that everything went really well! Huge thanks to everyone who took the time to fill out our [u][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdacXxF_HFihvSoBNgWFzAyGkJt0J7WchrOcwldUx0orwXodQ/viewform"]demo feedback survey[/url][/u]. We read every single response, and [b]your input has already sparked some ideas[/b] for little things we could do to enhance the experience further. For those interested, [b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1672810/MIO_Memories_in_Orbit/"]the demo is still available on Steam[/url][/u][/b] right now! Keep the feedback coming 🩵[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We’ve also spent a good deal of time watching your playthroughs, streams, and reactions. It’s been both incredibly interesting and rewarding to see you discover and talk about the game, see how you engage with it and navigate in it. The overall results have been very positive and it’s been amazing to learn which features resonated with you the most![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]For this summer devblog, we’ve decided to share a recap below (which includes old concept arts 👀)![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎨 Art direction & music: universally loved![/b][/h3][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]One of the most consistent pieces of feedback was praise for the [b]art direction[/b] and [b]music[/b]. These have been the core pillars of [i]MIO[/i] from the very beginning, so seeing them resonate with so many players is quite rewarding.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Fun fact: the art direction actually went through [b]three full reworks[/b] before we landed on the current style. While we're incredibly proud of where it ended up, our rendering dev still has a few ideas they'd love to push further, though that might have to wait for future projects. 🤭[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/b5e47f15ab04309cd08abbf8d82e6bba34d49c52.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🍥 Progression: a design choice[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]A few comments brought up things that were "missing" like fast travel or limited abilities early on, but these are actually [b]intentional design choices[/b]. [i]MIO[/i] is a metroidvania at heart, and progression is built around unlocking new powers and mechanics over time. We want players to [b]earn their way through the world[/b]! 💪[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]That sense of discovery, of gaining access to a new area or finally beating a boss after learning its patterns is part of what makes this genre special.[/p][p align="justify"]So yes, things like fast travel do exist. They just arrive later 😉[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/56d6691839d30cdf69a6291013dec8abfc74017c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚖️ The cleaving bits[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Some aspects of the game got [b]divided reactions[/b], which was to be expected and also something we’ve actually experienced before. When we released our first game, [b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116580/Shady_Part_of_Me/"]Shady Part of Me[/url][/u][/b], we were obsessively refreshing the Steam page to read the very first reviews. The first one was “It’s too easy.” The next? “It’s too difficult.” You get the idea. 🤗[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]For [i]MIO[/i], these divided aspects include:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]difficulty[/b] curve[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"simple to learn, hard to master"[/b] combat system
The [b]“soulful” level design[/b] with fewer handholds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="justify"]As always, it’s impossible to make a game that works for everyone. And that’s okay. Our philosophy has been to [b]own our intentions and core design choices[/b], while staying fair to the player. That means clearly communicating those choices and what kind of experience [i]MIO[/i] offers, so players know what they’re signing up for and won’t be disappointed.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We’ve also worked hard on [b]accessibility options[/b], which could be a great solution for players who want a slightly less difficult experience. Not options that just “make you invincible” and undermine the game, but [b]tweaks that help more casual players[/b] enjoy it without losing its intended feel. We will share more details about it when we're ready![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/4c2a9919e09730512d28da860f701acb1a4a6bfa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 What’s already fixed (or will be fixed)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p align="justify"]Some of your feedback pointed out issues that we’re already actively addressing or have already solved:[/p][list][*][p][b]2K / 4K display support[/b] ✅ (not implemented in the demo yet)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Option to disable low-HP screen borders[/b] ✅ (not implemented in the demo yet)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map & shop UI visuals[/b] 🔄[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance improvements[/b] 🔧[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="justify"]Right now, performance is a big focus for us and it has been for a long time. [b]While the game looks 2D, it’s actually fully 3D[/b], with procedural rendering and no loading screens between rooms, which makes optimization very tricky. However, there is no need to worry, we’ve been working on this for over a year and are committed to making sure [i]MIO[/i] runs smoothly on as many setups as possible by launch![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/5d4f074cb8235c92c27faae12e3a39358d42ceaf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛠 What needs work (and we’re on it)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p align="justify"]Lastly, a few areas came up that weren’t as well received and that are now on our radar:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]long path to Egis[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Some [b]guidance / navigation issues[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The [b]map & shop UI[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]jump reset bug[/b] (known and tricky, but currently being handled)[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]shop[/b] not feeling interesting enough[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"]These are all areas we’re now keeping a close eye on, and while some are trickier than others, we’re exploring ways to improve them wherever possible.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌞 Sun, dogs, and a bit of rest[/b][/h3][p][/p][p align="justify"]Right now, some of the team is also enjoying a well-deserved summer break, but we’re still [b]making the most of the time we have before release[/b]: polishing, refining, and adding final touches wherever we can to make the experience even better. 🫶[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]This summer, we also had the chance to attend our publisher’s summer party, and this time, [b]our producer brought both of her dogs[/b]! (She usually only brings [u][url="https://x.com/MIOinOrbit/status/1825559259574390995"]Ino[/url][/u] to the studio, but made an exception that week.) It was a perfect evening: great company, PERFECT weather, and a much-needed moment to relax together. 🍹[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/4eda000b0e264c908772271456643d2fe7655042.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Gamescom[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]We were at Gamescom this year, it was a great event as usual. We talked with journalists but also presented our demo to the public. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]It was great but we realised that this demo is really not optimized for this event 😅 it’s way too long and there is way too many people there. In the end, each person could only play the game between 15 to 20 minutes. A simple path with a short plateformer challenge ending with a boss would have been more appropriate.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Actually, that is exactly what Silksong presented during the event. We haven’t have the opportunity to play their demo unfortunately but we’ll all play the game soon 🫶[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/e7d108bf66b230be05c7e931d3ec9b082cdc39f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]We hope you enjoyed your summer as well, and we’ll be back soon with more news! We can’t wait to share more with you.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]See you soon! 💛[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Autumn Devblog 🍂
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone! ✨[/h2]

Once again we want to express our gratitude towards you for following the project. Reading your comments and seeing the wishlist grow makes us incredibly proud and excited (and a bit frightened too)! 💙 
We saw that some of you are still confused with the game; in terms of challenge, let us clarify that for you!

[h1]WHAT IS MIO?[/h1]

MIO is a metroidvania, therefore, it will be a challenging game. 
We often have playtesters telling us, at the beginning of their run, that they are afraid the game is going to be too casual because of the cute and poetic art style. 
Worry not, that is not what we aim for! So far, none of the players, testers or journalists got to the end without breaking a serious sweat or ended up thinking MIO was too easy.

Most realistically, you will die. A lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/970dfc6478069197fbbdeb25b96e355bf73d9234.gif[/img]

[h1]BALANCE IS KEY![/h1]

Even if MIO is going to have very demanding moments, there will also be more calm ones. We want to find balance between narration, mystery, exploration AND challenging platforming and combat moments.

Mio is a “lightweight” character, she’s agile and fast but quite fragile and lighter than most enemies she encounters. We wanted you to feel that.

It’s so exciting for us to see people gracefully dancing around obstacles & enemies after they’ve played for a while.

For sure you will retry and get better with every attempt! But the goal is to be fair so you should always be able to reach the end of the game. And that required a lot of iteration (still does !).

For the most adventurous of you, we’ve added several secret paths with special levels. 
We hope you will like them. ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/a69346880e5c94203f22cf419c9fcc2c274f581c.png[/img]

[h1]LANGUAGE, TEXT & VOICES![/h1]

We're working hard on the game and have just finished implementing all translations and voice over. There are going to be a lot of language options, we're happy so many people will be able to play the game in their native language!!

All the recordings went very well, we're very happy with the results. It was a little bit stressful since the main cinematics' emotions rely on those but we believe the result will be worth the effort.
In the end the actors & staff were amazing and it feels great to finally have them in the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/b65c9f7bda20c44948defcf8a970ee6e3c674bfa.png[/img]
[i]All translations available, voiced languages in yellow[/i]

[h1]THE MUSIC IS PART OF THE EXPERIENCE[/h1]

We’ve been working on implementing a real choir into the game’s soundtrack in order to find the "between robot and human" feel we wanted. We always wanted to have this contrast between the colder “sci fi” synths and the more organic human voices. Up until now our composer was working with small excerpts or placeholder voices, but no more !

We found a studio in Paris to do that, it took two days of recordings and a lot of work for our composer and singers. The results are simply amazing, and we’re sure you’ll love it too! 🎶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/41945593a887a619297a3835ffab80400e4b6535.png[/img]
Recording session at Midilive Studio, Paris

Since we’re currently in the polishing process, the game is getting better everyday. It is such an exciting (and tiring) period. 
For now we’re still implementing and debugging everything. It’s a lot of work and we don’t have much time so… we’re in a bit of a rush !

[h1]LITTLE SNEAK PEAK[/h1]

We have so many things we could show you but we don’t want to spoil too much…For those of you already enjoying snowy landscapes at home, and for those of you that wish you could see some snow this winter, how about this new snowfall that made it into the game just now? We have so many things we could show you but we don’t want to spoil too much…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/c41fb7d6a86e8b621818a1bcc2b13413aefece46.gif[/img]

Thanks a lot and see you next time! ⭐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065449/26a59acd625e23422a6881f0939f62a0822333a9.gif[/img]
